svg.title: From 418 passages to 38 articles
svg.desc: Seven stages: 418 passages; 418 vectors of 3072 numbers; one Ward tree; 7 chapters and 38 sections; 38 articles with 178 fused claims and 165 said once; 332 items of Seneca; 722 passages translated into Russian.
